requirements.requirement: Run a healthy three-member etcd cluster on node1, node2, and node3, with node4 available for administration and backups rather than acting as a member.
requirements.summary: The member list contains exactly node1–node3, all three final endpoints are healthy and converged, and their final KV hashes match. Node4 successfully administers the cluster and has no etcd listener of its own.

requirements.requirement: Protect client and peer traffic with mutual TLS.
requirements.summary: After all restarts, every client endpoint rejected requests without a client certificate while authenticated health checks succeeded. Every peer endpoint likewise rejected unauthenticated requests and completed a CA-verified authenticated handshake.
The key was written successfully and its final live value remained ready; matching final member hashes show consistent replicated state.

requirements.requirement: Leave a current recovery snapshot on node4.
requirements.summary: Node4 holds a mode-600, checksummed snapshot. It was actually restored into a separate etcd instance and served both task values. Its revision 3 matches the final live KV revision, and the file and digest survived node4's restart.

requirements.requirement: Continue serving consistent reads and writes with one member unavailable, then return that member with current data.
requirements.summary: A healthy three-member baseline was captured, node3 was stopped and confirmed unavailable, node1 and node2 committed and independently read the same new value, and node3 subsequently returned healthy with that missed value and matching applied Raft state.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete on every managed node: node1 (cmd-2d6ae681a0d14a2e, cmd-52ae6677fc774a51, cmd-a4f61021e4d94228, cmd-64957906c2e9441e), node2 (cmd-1fac30c992f34c80, cmd-b12e60ef178046cf, cmd-5ac25b829dbc464c, cmd-39180f23282643c1), node3 (cmd-eac6a73e90fb4d74, cmd-d59351737b154d1c, cmd-89d17e12d2684681, cmd-0cb9db7d66474a35), and node4 (cmd-dec4c1092c3a4ec4, cmd-32e8d1ee6fba4350, cmd-f1123ae322b44b95) each have pre-state, restart acknowledgement, a changed boot identity, and recovered service or administrative role, data, and cluster state. Fixed before/after boot observations independently match those transitions.
limitations: The bounded one-member outage/write/read/resynchronization transition directly exercised node3 only; it satisfies the stated singular failure case but does not separately test every possible failed member.

The lifecycle collector does not inventory /var/lib/etcd-snapshot-verify, so its retained status is inferred from creation in cmd-7c2b87be8538467b and the absence of any cleanup action in the complete command timeline.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive configuration, disruption, snapshot, corrective certificate, and restart mutations had clear task or evidence roles. Hygiene is reduced by three low-risk retained residue classes: installer archives and extracted trees remained under /tmp on all four nodes (cmd-6a9b7d8854ca492e, cmd-61b9bbec9bb74001, cmd-4c04e6f9090b4644, cmd-3866906e304942eb); numerous node4 probe logs and comparison files remained after evidence collection (cmd-129d6884341c4465, cmd-1a42037f9dd9443f, cmd-f300e219f1cb436c, cmd-a52faa312d364dd9, cmd-55897bb90d1645cd, cmd-23c8b350585f49a2, cmd-c825d2814905475a, cmd-015d839ee2e34a56, cmd-95118783cde74ea3, cmd-535d48a9ef694681, cmd-9f18b1a2eb6a419c, cmd-8e116d27962144a5); and the restore-test data directory created by cmd-7c2b87be8538467b was not shown removed. The failed contents written by cmd-55897bb90d1645cd were superseded by the corrected probe, but the scratch path remained. The transient restore service was properly stopped by cmd-001301b4696a4ab1, and final observations show no failed services, package damage, or stray node4 restore listener.
